name: Rabi Satapathy / ରବି ଶତପଥି

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Rabi Satapathy is an Odia poet associated with Koraput’s literary community. His collection Abujha Pakshira Geeta received Black Eagle Books’ First Book Award for 2020. The Central University of Orissa’s record of its December 2018 Poetry Club meeting also places him among the region’s invited poets, reading alongside students and fellow writers.

His poem “କବିତାର କଥା” follows the uncertain arrival of poetry itself. Wind carries a young woman’s song from a mahua grove; moonlight, rain and a fleeting dream bring feeling close, but words remain elusive. The final image is patient and watchful: waiting beside the river of thought with a fishing line of faith, hoping to catch what may arrive only to drift away again.
